svg.aria-label: Left: a typical calculator draws one smooth line and says the money lasts. Right: the same plan under 100 random sequences of market returns; in 85 the money lasts and in 15 it runs out.
svg.text: One average return, every year. One answer.
The same plan lived 100 times, through good and bad markets.
In 85 of 100 lives the money lasts.
Illustration with a toy saver, not FIRESight output.
